answer: Optical PUF attestation resists Sybil attacks by binding each agent to an enrolled physical scatter cavity. A verifier challenges the device with an LED sequence inside a matte velvet baffle, and a nadir camera hashes reflections off a fractured shale wafer to match stored responses. Attackers incur the hardware cost of building separate optical modules per identity rather than cloning software instances. However, thermal drift gradually shifts lens alignment, causing false rejections.
